en-US.title: RTSH TANI
en-US.subtitle: Live TV & radio from Albania
en-US.description:
RTSH TANI brings Albania's public broadcaster to your phone and tablet. Watch RTSH television channels live, listen to RTSH radio stations, and catch up on the programmes you missed.

LIVE TELEVISION
Stream RTSH channels live in adaptive quality that adjusts to your connection. Choose the quality yourself whenever you want, or let the app handle it.

RADIO THAT KEEPS PLAYING
RTSH radio stations with full background playback and lock-screen controls. Lock your phone or switch apps — the audio keeps going.

FULL TV GUIDE
Browse the complete schedule for every channel, seven days back and seven days ahead. Open any programme to read its description.

CATCH-UP
Missed something? Play it back straight from the guide. Pause, rewind and scrub through any recorded programme.

BUILT FOR EVERY SCREEN
Designed for iPhone and iPad, with picture-in-picture so you can keep watching while you do something else.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Albanian by default, with English available. Light and dark themes.

PARENTAL CONTROLS
Set a PIN on this device to gate age-restricted programming.

RTSH TANI is the official application of Radio Televizioni Shqiptar. An account is required. Some content may not be available in all regions.
en-US.promoText: Watch RTSH live — television and radio from Albania's public broadcaster. Full TV guide, catch up on the last seven days, and radio that keeps playing in the background.

review.notes:
ACCESS
No account is needed to use the app. On first launch the welcome screen offers "Continue without an account" as a full-width button of the same size and weight as Sign in. Choosing it gives immediate access to all live TV channels, all radio stations, the full 7-day guide and search. No personal information is requested.
An account is required only for account-based features: catch-up playback of past programmes, age-restricted programmes, enabling the parental PIN, and profile management.

1. DEVICES TESTED (physical hardware)
- iPhone 12 Pro Max, iOS 26.x - full flow
- iPhone 17 Pro, iOS 26.x - full flow, Release configuration
- iPad Pro 11-inch (M5), iPadOS 26.x - full flow, Release configuration

2. FUNCTION AND AUDIENCE
RTSH TANI is the official OTT app of Radio Televizioni Shqiptar (RTSH), Albania's national public service broadcaster. It gives the Albanian public free access to RTSH's own live TV and radio, a 7-day guide, and catch-up of programmes already aired. RTSH's broadcast signal reaches only Albania, so Albanians abroad had no official way to watch. Free: no subscriptions, no in-app purchases.
Audience: Albanian speakers of all ages; a device-level parental PIN gates age-restricted programming.

3. SETUP AND ACCESS
No setup or sample files needed. One account type, no roles.

GUEST PATH - please start here:
1. Launch the app. On the welcome screen tap "Continue without an account".
2. Home: tap any channel tile for live playback. The Radio toggle switches to radio stations.
3. Guide: the 7-day schedule, fully browsable.
4. Player: tap the screen for controls; the options sheet holds quality and audio tracks.
5. Radio continues in the background and on the lock screen - a core feature, not a bug.

ACCOUNT PATH - demo account: ott@rtsh.al / 11111111
6. Sign in from Profile, or tap any account-gated item. An account can also be created from Register, confirmed by a one-time code emailed to that address.
7. Guide: tap a programme that already aired to play it back (catch-up).
8. Profile > Delete account removes the account and all associated data.

Two behaviours that can look like bugs but are intentional: with Settings > "play over cellular" off, a confirmation appears before playback on a cellular connection - tap Continue. Parental control is off by default.

No sensitive permissions are requested: no location, camera, microphone, contacts, photos, or ATT prompt. The only system capabilities used are background audio and Picture-in-Picture.

4. EXTERNAL SERVICES
- RTSH/MCN backend (api.mcn-mw.com), operated for RTSH by its technology partner: authentication, channel catalogue, EPG, HLS playback manifests, and a WebSocket for real-time programme and availability updates. All traffic is HTTPS/WSS.
- Content delivery: RTSH's own CDN/origin serves the HLS streams. No third-party DRM.
- Sentry (Functional Software, Inc.): crash and performance diagnostics only, EU data region. Auth tokens are stripped; only an opaque internal account identifier is attached.
- Expo Application Services (EAS): builds and over-the-air JavaScript updates, developer-side only.
No third-party advertising or analytics SDKs, payment processors, AI services, or auth providers. Advertising is RTSH's own promotional spots from the RTSH backend.

5. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app functions identically in all regions and all content is currently available worldwide, including from the United States. It contains regional-availability handling because RTSH's rights are territorial and may change; a restricted channel would show a notice rather than fail. Nothing is restricted at the time of this submission. The only regional variation is language: Albanian by default, English selectable in Settings > Language.

6. AUTHORIZATION
RTSH TANI is published by Radio Televizioni Shqiptar itself, Albania's national public broadcaster. It streams only RTSH's own channels and archive.
